### The Only True Freedom
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-only-true-freedom
Passage: John 8:31-32
Points:
- True freedom requires having the desire, ability, and opportunity to pursue what satisfies forever.
- Mustering sheer willpower to do what one dislikes is not genuine liberty.
- Any action that ultimately destroys a person cannot be considered authentic freedom.
- Only Jesus Christ provides lasting joy without regret through His death and resurrection.

### Finding Freedom in Christ (John 8:36)
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/finding-freedom-in-christ-bible-study-minute-december-19-2017.html
Passage: John 8:36
Points:
- True deliverance belongs to Christ alone, who possesses the rightful authority to free captives.
- This liberty was dearly bought by Christ bearing our burdens and suffering in our place.
- Jesus gives freedom freely to sinners as they are, without demanding prior self-reformation.
- The liberty granted by Christ is perpetual, shielding believers from ultimate condemnation.
- Freedom from sin's curse leads believers to serve God with joyful gratitude.

### When You Obey Jesus, You Become More like Him
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-11-2026.html
Passage: John 8:31-32
Points:
- Discipleship is a lifelong, incremental journey rather than an instant achievement.
- Spiritual maturity is measured by practical obedience rather than accumulated head knowledge.
- Feeding upon and obeying God's Word is the essential foundation for spiritual growth.
- Walking in Christ's truth liberates people from guilt, bad habits, and external pressures.
- Consistent obedience steadily transforms believers into the character of Jesus.

### Grace and Freedom
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-21-2023.html
Passage: John 8:32
Points:
- Christ's truth is intended to liberate believers from legalistic prisons and guilt.
- While Christian liberty requires wisdom, restraint must come from individual conscience rather than external legislation.
- Forcing rules on others produces legalism and stifles grace.
- The Holy Spirit is responsible for restraining believers, while our calling is to encourage freedom.
- Meditating on God's promises of liberty renews the soul and awakens grace daily.
